title: Abstract Class vs Interface
description: Choose between abstract classes and interfaces.

data.text: Both abstract classes and interfaces define contracts, but they serve different purposes. Understanding when to use each is key to good design.

items: Abstract Class – 'is-a' relationship, can have state
A class can implement multiple interfaces but inherit only one class

data.title: Comparison
Key Takeaways
points: Use abstract classes for shared base behavior
A class can implement multiple interfaces
data.takeaway: Choose abstract classes for 'is-a' and interfaces for 'can-do' relationships.
